title: Professional Certificate Course in Concepts in Global Supply Chain Ecosystem
description: To understand the key concepts and strategies necessary to navigate the dynamic global supply chain ecosystem.
longDescription: In this Professional Certificate Course, participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the key concepts and strategies necessary to manage and optimize global supply chain operations. The course covers the nature of the supply chain ecosystem, the concept of supply chain de-verticalization, supply chain trends such as modularity and outsourcing, and the role of institutions in supply chain management. Additionally, the course covers economic, regulatory, and trade-related innovations that impact global supply chains, as well as the management of supply chain resources and the concept of supply chain clusters. Upon completion, participants will have a strong foundation in supply chain management and be prepared to excel in a variety of roles in the field.
